title: MZ [Class Change System VisuStella MZ ] Actor multiclass ID in battle

posts.author: Akou
posts.body:
Hi, (sorry for my english, not my native langage)
The plugin
Class Change System
by VisuStella give the possibility to get the data of classes and multiclasses that an actor has with :
actor.multiclasses()
- This returns an array of all of the multiclasses an actor has.
- This includes the actor's primary class.
actor.multiclass(x)
- This returns the class data (not ID) of whatever class the actor has
in x multiclass slot.
- An x value of 1 would yield the primary class.
actor.multiclassId(x)
- This returns the class ID (not data) of whatever class the actor has
in x multiclass slot.
- An x value of 1 would yield the primary class's ID.
Click to expand...
I have an issue when I set a skill who use an Event to have one of the active actor's multiclass in a variable.
Instead of having the ID of the multiclass, the return is zero.
As the description above says, I use the code
actor.multiclassId(x)
(with x equal to the desired multiclass).
I tested several variations using codes I found in the sheet
RPG MAKER MV / MZ Script Calls
but I haven't been able to find a solution (if there is one).
Am I missing something obvious?

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
Akou said:
Just to be sure, does this script return the active actor's id?
$gameActors.actor($gameTemp._lastActionData[2])
Click to expand...
It wouldn't be completely accurate to say it's the active one, but it'll generally be true. It's really the last actor to act, starting from the start of their action.
The distinction matters depending on your battle system. For example, in an ATB system, if actor A acts and now it's actor B's turn but they haven't acted yet, then the script would get you actor A even though actor B is the active actor.
